name: dropzone
title: Dropzone
description: A drop zone that unfolds into a file list row by row and folds back on Clear. It only lists the files and hands you the File objects; nothing is uploaded.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)
docs:
Dropzone from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Dropzone } from "@/components/ui/motion-dropzone".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-dropzone.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createDropzone on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/dropzone/dropzone.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#dropzone
